<style>

  padding: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--neutral-n75);

}

.seminar-feature-image img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 180px;
  height: auto;
}

.seminar-feature-text h3 {

}

.seminar-feature-text > :last-child {

}

  .seminar-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
